rule: amendment 5, big data. Data properties only, no model output.

TRAIN = manifest split train. SELECT/REPORT = manifest split val2 divided by 100 km spatial block (connected components, tiles closer than 100 km on any date), never splitting a block or a tile-level episode.

Per region (group_name) blocks are visited by descending fire-level MODIS pixels and given to the side holding fewer of that region's fire pixels; fixed seed. See src/nightrad/raw/nf2_split.py. REPORT numbers are never looked at before stage 5.
